title: AuthorityOutcome
description: The A0-A5 authority outcome carried on every call across the Go/Python boundary (ADR-0006 §2.5; ZTAX-AIGOV-001 §4). A5 is a member rather than being absent, because a request can arrive claiming A5 and the governance layer has to be able to name what it refused. A5 is technically blocked: the Go policy gate (backend/internal/domain/ai) and the Python Gateway (ztax_gateway.governance) both refuse it unconditionally, and no registry object may declare it as a ceiling.
$comment: The order of the enum is the order of the levels. Go: ai.AuthorityOutcomes. Python: ztax_gateway.provenance.AuthorityOutcome. Both are tested equal to this list.
